name: Long Beach Recreation Program Leader (temporary)
org: City of Long Beach Parks, Recreation and Marine
what_you_do: Part-time city recreation job: plan and run activities for children, go to staff meetings and training, and keep kids safe. Hours can reach 40 a week from June through August.
who_can_apply: Must be at least 16 years old. If under 18, you must have a valid permit to work.
pay_detail: Hourly by level: $16.76 (Specialist III), $17.31 (IV), $18.09 (V), $20.87 (VII). The level depends on your qualifications.
duration: Temporary; hours vary by week and may reach 40 per week June through August
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page mentions a job fair on Saturday, Jan. 24, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Houghton Park (year not stated).
how_to_apply: Use the 'Apply Here for Recreation Jobs' link, which goes to governmentjobs.com (search for recreation). Tech help: (877) 204-4442.
notes: Pay rates are as posted on the page (the page does not date them). Under-18 applicants need a valid permit to work. Ask the department which level a first-time worker starts at. Accommodation requests: (562) 570-3188.
